source_name: PhosR-derived L6 reference bundle (phospho.L6.ratio.pe, PhosphoSite.mouse, motif.mouse.list)
retrieval_method: Generated from locally installed PhosR R package data objects with scripts/active/generate_r_l6_fixtures.R; packaged as CSVs under src/phospy/data/reference_bundles/rat/l6_native on 2026-04-16.
license: Upstream PhosR package metadata declares GPL-3 + file LICENSE. Upstream PhosR documentation also identifies PhosphoSite.mouse as extracted from PhosphoSitePlus and phospho.L6.ratio.pe as PRIDE-sourced; no separate license grant for this derived CSV snapshot is recorded here.
redistribution_status: Redistribution approval for this exact derived rat bundle is not independently verified; packaged with PhosR attribution and explicit third-party source caveats, and must not be used as approval precedent for other reference bundles.
redistribution_basis: PhosR package metadata and repository declare GPL-3 + file LICENSE, but upstream docs identify PhosphoSitePlus and PRIDE-derived source content. No independent written redistribution permission for the exact derived bundle is recorded.
provenance_notes: Generation script loads PhosR objects phospho.L6.ratio.pe, PhosphoSite.mouse, and motif.mouse.list.
Upstream PhosR documentation says PhosphoSite.mouse is extracted from PhosphoSitePlus and phospho.L6.ratio.pe is an L6 myotube phosphoproteome dataset with PRIDE accession notes.
The exact local PhosR package version used to create the 2026-04-16 CSV snapshot is not captured in the packaged files; source_version identifies the PhosPy packaged snapshot.
Packaged CSV hashes fingerprint the redistributed files only; they are not independent upstream license approvals.
limitations: Rat-only bundled reference lane in this release.
Uses mouse PhosR kinase-substrate and motif objects with a rat L6 phosphoproteome lane, matching the generation script; this is scientific provenance, not a new organism-support claim.
Exact upstream PhosR package version, PhosphoSitePlus license grant, and PRIDE dataset redistribution terms for the derived CSV snapshot are not independently verified in this repository.
Do not treat this bundle as approval to redistribute other PhosR, PhosphoSitePlus, Kinase Library, or PRIDE-derived resources.
Not suitable for unsupported organisms unless caller supplies an explicit external ReferenceBundle.
